-l: Sets a single username to try
-L: Sets a wordlist file of usernames — login attempts scale with the number of lines in the file
-p: Sets a single password to try
-P: Sets a password wordlist file — larger files take longer and raise the risk of account lockout / IDS-fail2ban detection
-t: Number of parallel threads — higher speeds things up but raises the risk of account lockout/detection
-w: Wait time (seconds) between attempts — higher helps evade lockout/IDS but slows things down
-M: Sets a file listing multiple targets — attacks several hosts at once in a single command
